summary.name: Machine Learning Specialization (Supervised Machine Learning: Regression and Classification)
summary.one_liner: A beginner-friendly Coursera online course, taught by Andrew Ng, that teaches supervised machine learning with linear and logistic regression using Python, NumPy and scikit-learn.
use_cases: prepare for an AI or machine learning career
summary.what_it_does: This is the first course in the 3-course Machine Learning Specialization on Coursera, created by DeepLearning.AI and Stanford Online and taught by Andrew Ng. The course covers building and training supervised models for prediction and binary classification, including linear regression and logistic regression. Students implement models in Python using NumPy and scikit-learn. The wider Specialization also covers neural networks, decision trees, clustering, dimensionality reduction, recommender systems, and model evaluation and tuning. It is described as an updated, expanded version of Ng's earlier Machine Learning course.
notable: Taught by Andrew Ng, created with DeepLearning.AI and Stanford Online
Updated successor to Andrew Ng's original Machine Learning course, rated 4.9 out of 5
Hands-on Python work with NumPy and scikit-learn
